title: Crescent Saloon, Vic Dubar's dance hall and Pinky Allen's barbershop
summary: Memories of the Basin, Rampart Street dance hall above Pinky Allen's barbershop and saloon, and the fighters' trainer Kid Green.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Do you remember the Crescent Saloon? Crescent Tonk, Crescent Saloon? Oh yeah, I remember that.

I remember Savokas, Vic Dubar. I remember Vic Dubar, that's a big dance. That's before they closed the bass. The bass, and schooners used to come in the bass, and I, from Mandeville, a different place, come in there with watermillers, chicken. I heard of many hogs hollering in the sack. They put them hogs in the sack, you know, and bring them in there on the bass. And that time the bass was wide open, all the way to Rampart Street. And they had the giant right there in Howard Avenue Rampart they called Vic Dubar. The guys danced there, and they had another place they called Pratt's at Iperville, I mean, at Lafayette in Rampart. A fellow by the name of Kid Green, he used to train all these private fighters around there. He used to operate there, I mean, at Lafayette and Rampart.
You remember a fellow named Pinky Allen at the old man's saloon?

Yeah, I remember Pinky Allen. He had cut my hair, sure. He cut my hair right there. He had a barbershop right there in Howard Avenue Rampart. And he had this old man's saloon? Yeah, the old man's saloon. And Vic Dubar was right over Pinky Allen's where they danced upstairs.
They danced upstairs and his saloon was downstairs?
Yeah, and Pinky Allen's downstairs, that's right.
